blocks.text: This is a timely message. So many events are transpiring in the U.S. as well as in the rest of the world. There are many letters that I have posted in the past, starting down in 2005. I took a particular look at the message that Brother Frisby placed in my hands. They pointed to all the events that I published, denoting the catastrophic weather that all nations have seen in the last 5 years. No one can deny the severe weather that has happened worldwide as well as major earthquakes and volcano activity stepping up, also hurricanes and tornadoes. (Luke 21:25-28) They will be getting more violent the closer we come to the return of the Lord. For the violence and the corrupt immoral dishonesty that is worldwide in all governments, truly they have passed the point of no return! Surely the cup of iniquity is full! According to the Bible when sin reaches to the heights of heaven there will be swift judgement. That brings me to an event, the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah. – Scientists now proved that this event took place just as the Bible declared it. I will explain this in one of my upcoming letters that shows exactly how God knew this event ahead of time. He sent two angel messengers to give the warning! And as we know only Lot and his 2 daughters escaped. – Worldwide events are taking place in the financial markets as predicted in my past letters. More is yet to come. The debt crisis is eminent and the debts of the people and the governments are rising at an astronomical rate bringing us to the brink of a catastrophe that will change all worldwide currencies. The anti-Christ is on the move, for he is a resource man and will dominate all nations as he comes in as a peacemaker, which eventually turns into a reign of terror. I will go into more detail in a future letter just how this event is coming about. And seemingly the world is totally unaware of the great deceiving that will take place. I have so much to say that I’ll have to put it in other letters. I have a wonderful quote from Brother Frisby. This will strengthen you and give you the courage for the closing hours of this elect message. Remember the Scriptures say that it almost deceived the very elect, but did not! (Matt. 24:24) And now a quote from Neal Frisby.

“The Scriptures say, be not deceived as the time draweth near! – In other words, we would be in a period of worldwide deception and certainly it is all around us! Plus all sorts of delusions. But Jesus is in our midst and is directing His people into His true works!” Mark 1:15, “The time is fulfilled and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel! – The nations and people are full of fear and unrest. Perplexity and confusion seem to abound as the earth shakes from one event to the other! – We know people, and even the Lord’s people need rest, confidence and peace!” DID YOU KNOW THAT JESUS LOVES YOU? – And has given His full benefits to ALL who believe – act on His Word! SALVATION – Eph. 2:8-9, “For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourself: it is the gift of God!” I John 1:9 says, “If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins!” Heb. 2:3, “How shall we escape; if we neglect so great salvation.” NEED HEALING? – Mark 9:23, Jesus said, “All things are possible to him that believeth!” – St. John 14:14, “Ask anything in my name (Jesus) and I will do it.” Ps. 103:3, “Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases!” DEBT BURDENED? – St. Matt. 11:28-29, “Christ will remove the heavy laden, and give you rest!” NEED PROSPERITY? – St. Matt. 7:7, “Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock and it shall be opened unto you!” III John 1:2, “Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth!” NEED PEACE AND REST? – II Tim.1:7, “God will take away the spirit of fear, give power and love and a sound mind!” NEED STRENGTH? – Isa. 40:31, “They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength!” – ENDURANCE shall mount up as eagles – run and not be weary – shall walk – and not faint! DIVINE HEALTH – Absorbing God’s word – produce life, longevity and health to all that keep them! – Prov. 4:20-22 – read Deut. 34:7 – Renewed body and youth! Ps. 103:5 – NEED HOLY SPIRIT? – Acts 2:38, “Repent, be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.” St. John 3:5, “Except a man be born of water and spirit he cannot enter the kingdom of God!” St. Matt. 21:22, “And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.” – Accept it now! “If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth!” (Mark 9:23) – “This reveals to the believer unlimited answers to prayer!” End quote. – Truly these are sound words to be practiced every day for they will give you strength and understanding of the Scriptures.

I have wonderful news! We have the new book of The Prophetic Special Writings – Volume Number Three ready to release, as well as a wonderful DVD called “Authoritative Faith!” (See offer below.) – Truly the Lord has been good to us. We have bought two new printers to continue publishing these wonderful books. Your support has truly been wonderful. The Lord’s blessings will rest upon those who help as well as those who have received the message. Great thanks and gratitude have come from all around the world. We truly appreciate all of the confidence and support that you have so freely given to this ministry. May the Lord continue to bless and guide each and every one of you.

All three new CD’s/Cassettes, $15.00 donation: New DVD release: “Authoritative Faith!” “The Word Or Delusion” “The Jonah Dilemma” Also available: “God Calculates!” “The Anointed Seed” ($20.00 donation each)
